chunks: After having turned to carious bones?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'bones worn away' in the context of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This verse, situated within the discourse of Surah Ya-Sin, employs the imagery of 'nakhira' (hollowed-out or crumbling bones) to challenge the materialistic skepticism of the disbelievers regarding bodily resurrection. In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question underscores not only God's omnipotence to recreate matter from dust but also serves as a precursor to the promise of a new, perfected creation, affirming the continuity of the soul and the body in the Hereafter.
